Grip Sling Swivel.


TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS:

  • MANUFACTURER – GUN POWER NATION.

  • COUNTRY OF MANUFACTURE – UKRAINE.

  • OVERALL DIMENSIONS – 67,5x43x2 MM.

  • MATERIAL – STEEL 45.

  • WEIGHT – 26 G.

  • WEAPON MODEL – AKM/AKMS, AK-74, MK-72, SAIGA-MK CARBINES.

  • MANUFACTURING METHOD – LASER CUTTING.

  • PROTECTIVE COATING – OXIDATION.


EQUIPMENT:

  • PISTOL GRIP SLING SWIVEL – 1 PC.


PRODUCT DESCRIPTION:

The pistol grip plate is made of high-quality steel sheet. The shape of the plate allows the weapon strap to be attached to the plate's bow. The cutouts in the product's design allow the plate to be installed on the pistol grip mounting location and secured with the pistol grip itself.
